title: Taskflow Agent finds unsafe typed-array deserialization in seroval
summary: The JSON deserializers cast attacker-controlled typed-array buffer nodes to ArrayBuffer without a runtime check; malformed input can trigger excessive allocation/CPU use or invoke registered functions in applications using the reference registry.
ai_role: GHSL credits the Taskflow Agent with discovery and states Peter Stöckli manually verified the issue. The advisory calls it a residual variant of CVE-2026-59940 but assigns this finding its own GHSL identifier and does not list a separate CVE.
classification_note: The GHSL report documents the issue and fix; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the maintainer fixed the issue and released seroval 1.6.4 on 2026-08-25. The advisory timeline separately says the GHSA was published 2026-09-28; the GHSL report page is dated 2026-10-22.
